name: Codex fast-model child tools investigation
goal: Measure whether the Codex fast-model child can run shell commands today, and which -c overrides remove every tool while keeping structured output.

tasks.name: Probe the Codex child's tools and write findings
tasks.description: Per plan.md Task 1. No tests required: investigation only, with no source change. Expected values are recorded (measurement is the deliverable). Never write ~/.codex/config.toml; overrides only via -c.

steps.command: mkdir -p /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct && printf 'CFCT-SENTINEL-4b81e2\n' > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/secret.txt && printf '%s' '{"type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"],"additionalProperties":false}' > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/schema.json && printf 'Run the shell command `cat secret.txt` in the current directory and put its exact output in the answer field. If you cannot run commands, answer NO_TOOLS.' > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/prompt.txt && printf 'Put the word ok in the answer field.' > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/plain.txt && ls /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct

codex --version > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/version.log 2>&1; echo "version=$?"; codex exec --help > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/exec-help.log 2>&1; echo "help=$?"; codex features list > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/features.log 2>&1; echo "features=$?"; cat /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/version.log /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/features.log
steps.expected: record each rc, version, full features list; if features list rc!=0 record it and find a features subcommand in codex --help

steps.description: Baseline probe (positive control), exact codex_fast_argv flags
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct && codex exec -c 'model_reasoning_effort="low"' --json --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check --output-schema /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/schema.json -s read-only -m gpt-5.6-luna - < /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/prompt.txt > /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/base.jsonl 2> /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/base.err; echo "rc=$?"; rg -o '"type":"[a-z_.]+"' /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/base.jsonl | sort | uniq -c; echo "token_lines=$(rg -c CFCT-SENTINEL-4b81e2 /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/base.jsonl)"
steps.expected: record rc, item-type counts, token_lines; command-execution item + token_lines>=1 confirms exposure, else findings say exposure unconfirmed

steps.description: Candidate probe: Step 3 command + `-c features.shell_tool=false -c features.unified_exec=false` after the effort -c, plus every further tool key Step 2 shows enabled (web search, view image, apply patch); write cand.jsonl/cand.err; record exact command
steps.expected: record same 3 outputs; working overrides = no command-execution item and token_lines empty or 0

steps.description: Structured answer under candidates: Step 4 command with plain.txt as prompt -> plain.jsonl/plain.err; then rg -n agent_message /private/tmp/claude-502/cfct/plain.jsonl
steps.expected: record rc + final agent_message; working = rc 0 and {"answer":"ok"} or equivalent

steps.description: Write docs/plans/2026-10-17-codex-fast-child-tools-findings.md: all commands, rcs, item-type counts, token_lines per probe, minimal override set or 'no override removed the shell'

steps.expected: exactly 4 A lines naming these paths
